Answer: C
Reason: The provided axial CT image shows a prominent soft tissue mass in the left paratracheal/mediastinal region (left hilum area) adjacent to the trachea. In the context of tracheal squamous cell carcinoma and dysphonia, this finding correlates with tumor invasion or compression of the recurrent laryngeal nerve or direct tracheal involvement, which would appear as hilar/mediastinal enlargement on a chest X-ray.
